Role OverviewWe are looking for an experienced SAP Solution Architect to lead the design, implementation, and governance of our SAP S/4HANA landscape, with a strong focus on Finance, enterprise integrations, banking solutions, and process automation.The role will be responsible for building scalable and secure SAP architecture, integrating SAP with in-house applications and third-party platforms, and driving automation across finance operations. The ideal candidate should have deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance, hands-on experience with banking integrations, and the ability to collaborate closely with Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, Security, and external implementation partners in a high-volume, fast-paced business environment.
Key ResponsibilitiesOwn end-to-end solution architecture for SAP S/4HANA, ensuring alignment with business requirements, technology strategy, scalability, and performance.Design and govern integrations between SAP S/4HANA and internal applications using APIs, IDocs, OData, REST/SOAP web services, and middleware platforms.Architect and optimize SAP Finance processes across Financial Accounting (FI), Asset Accounting (AA), General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Bank Accounting.Lead the architecture and implementation of automated invoice processing solutions to improve accuracy, scalability, and operational efficiency.Design and support Host-to-Host (H2H) banking integrations for payment processing, bank statement automation, electronic bank reconciliation, and treasury operations.Drive Supply Chain Finance (SCF) integrations with banking partners and financial institutions.Ensure secure, reliable, and compliant integrations with external banking systems, payment platforms, and financial service providers.Review and approve functional and technical solution designs developed by internal teams and implementation partners.Define architecture standards, integration patterns, technical governance frameworks, and best practices across SAP and connected enterprise applications.Partner with Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, and Security teams to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions.Lead solution design for new finance initiatives, business process transformations, acquisitions, and regulatory changes.Drive SAP upgrades, release planning, and transformation initiatives while ensuring business continuity and minimizing operational disruption.Identify opportunities to automate finance workflows, reduce manual interventions, improve reconciliation efficiency, and optimize system performance.Ensure adherence to information security, financial controls, audit, compliance, and internal governance requirements.
Required Skills & Experience10+ years of SAP experience, with 3–5 years in Solution Architecture.Strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance implementation, design, and support.Deep knowledge of SAP FI, AA, GL, AP, AR, and Bank Accounting.Experience integrating SAP with internal and third-party applications using APIs, IDocs, OData, REST/SOAP, and middleware platforms such as SAP PI/PO, Integration Suite, MuleSoft, or Boomi.Proven experience in invoice automation, H2H banking integrations, payment processing, bank reconciliation, and Supply Chain Finance (SCF).Strong understanding of financial controls, audit, security, and compliance.Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred QualificationsExperience in Quick Commerce, E-commerce, Retail, FMCG, Logistics, or Supply Chain.Exposure to high-volume transactions, SAP Fiori, SAP BTP, and cloud integration platforms.Knowledge of finance workflow automation and document management solutions.SAP S/4HANA certification preferred.
Success MetricsScalable, secure, and reliable SAP architecture that supports business growth.Stable and seamless integrations between SAP, internal applications, and banking partners.Increased automation across invoice processing, payments, and bank reconciliation.Reduced manual interventions, processing errors, and reconciliation timelines.Strong architecture governance, financial controls, security, and regulatory compliance.Timely delivery of architecture solutions for strategic finance initiatives and business transformation projects.

Role OverviewThe Zonal EHS Manager will be responsible for implementing and monitoring Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) programs across multiple delivery hubs and fulfillment centres. The role involves ensuring statutory compliance, managing safety risks, driving audits, and building a strong safety culture across operations.
Key ResponsibilitiesEnsure compliance with Indian EHS regulations and statutory requirements.Oversee EHS audits, inspections, and safety compliance across 300–350 delivery hubs and 5–6 fulfillment centres.Implement and standardize EHS policies, SOPs, and safety checklists across locations.Lead risk assessments, incident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.Manage fire safety, electrical safety, contractor safety, chemical handling, and emergency preparedness.Conduct safety training, fire drills, and vendor compliance audits.Monitor EHS KPIs, prepare dashboards, and drive monthly performance reviews.Collaborate with Operations, HR, Engineering, Expansion, and Procurement teams.Mentor site-level EHS teams and drive ISO 45001 implementation and certification readiness.

Role Overview:As a Product Manager – Rider Experience at Zepto, you will own the end-to-end rider app journey for order fulfilment. That journey runs from order pickup at the store to delivery at the customer's doorstep, and back. You will design and optimize the experience for thousands of delivery partners, improving rider productivity, delivery speed, and fulfilment cost. This role suits a product manager who thrives at the intersection of on-ground operations, user experience, and data-driven decision-making in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Key Responsibilities:● Own the product strategy and roadmap for the rider fulfilment journey. This spans order assignment, pickup and handshake at the store, navigation to customer addresses and inside societies, route handling, and the return journey to the store.● Design journeys for complex order types such as batched, multi-store, same-society, multi-shipment, and relay deliveries.● Build and improve special flows such as returns, replacements, open box delivery, pharma, and 3P delivery partner flows.● Own proof of delivery flows to reduce order losses, customer complaints, and cost.● Own the in-app guidance for new riders to drive engagement and retention.● Work with control tower and operations teams on real-time fulfilment tooling, and drive special launches that need quick on-ground execution.● Use data, experimentation, and on-ground research to improve delivery time, rider productivity, retention, and cost per order. Own outcomes beyond launch.● Work closely with design, engineering, analytics, data science, and operations, and lead product planning, sprint execution, and release cycles with clarity and urgency.
Qualifications:● 2–4 years of experience in product management, ideally in consumer tech, e-commerce, logistics, or mobile-first platforms.● Proven track record of owning and delivering products at scale, preferably in supply-side, operations, or gig-workforce products.● Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Computer Science, or a related field; MBA is a plus.● Experience working with agile product development teams and shipping iteratively.
Required Skills:● Strong product thinking and user empathy, with the ability to design for users in high-pressure, on-ground environments.● Deep understanding of data and metrics, and comfort with SQL and product analytics tools like Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Looker.● Ability to identify problems through data and own outcomes after launch, not just delivery.● Familiarity with user research, A/B testing, and experimentation frameworks.● Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.● Strong execution rigour, high attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple initiatives in parallel.

Senior Security Engineer (Security Engineer III)Location: Bengaluru | Experience: 4 to 9 years
About Zepto:Zepto is India's quick-commerce company, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Bengaluru.We deliver groceries and everyday essentials in minutes through a network of 1,000+ darkstores, serving tens of millions of customers and millions of orders every day.
About the role:Security at this scale and speed has to be built into how engineering works, not bolted on at theend. We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer who builds: security tooling, CI/CD securitygates, and automation that developers actually use.This is a hands-on role. You'll own security automation and DevSecOps, review architecture andthreat models, and find real vulnerabilities in code and APIs.
What you'll do:● Design, build, and maintain security tooling and CI/CD security gates (SAST, secrets,SCA, IaC, container scanning)● Write and tune custom detection rules (Semgrep, CodeQL or similar) with a focus onhigh signal and low noise● Use AI coding tools to build fast, and critically review what they produce● Review architecture and threat models for new systems and features● Perform secure code reviews and hands-on testing of APIs, web, and mobile backends,including business logic flaws● Identify and fix cloud and Kubernetes misconfigurations● Partner with engineering teams to drive adoption, handle exceptions, and make securedefaults the easy path● Track the impact of what you build (false positive rate, adoption, time to fix)● Mentor other engineers on security automation and engineering practices
What we're looking for?Must have: ● 4+ years in application security, product security, or DevSecOps● Track record of building and shipping security tools or automation that others rely on● Hands-on experience integrating security into CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CIor similar)● Proficiency in Python, Go, or a similar language, and comfort reading Java/Go/Nodecodebases● Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, API Security Top 10, and business logicvulnerabilities● Working knowledge of AWS security and Kubernetes security fundamentals● Ability to influence engineering teams without authority
Good to have: ● Open source contributions (security tools, rules, research)● Security research: CVEs, blogs, conference talks, bug bounty track record● Experience with ASPM platforms or vulnerability management pipelines● Experience using LLMs in security workflows● Background in high-scale consumer internet, e-commerce, or fintechWhy join● Secure one of India's fastest-growing consumer platforms at real scale● High ownership: what you build ships across the company● Work with a hands-on team that builds, breaks, and automates

Software Development Engineer I — Frontend (Web)Location: Bengaluru, India | Experience: 1-2 Years | Team: Fulfillment Web
About the Role:Delivering groceries and essentials in minutes requires deeply integrated, high-throughput supply chain and fulfillment technology operating behind the scenes.We are looking for a high-ownership Software Development Engineer I (SDE-1) to join our Fulfillment Web team. In this role, you will architect, build, and scale mission-critical web applications that power our end-to-end fulfillment ecosystem. You will solve complex UI and state management challenges at scale, with opportunities to contribute to backend APIs and build and utilize AI-powered workflows that accelerate business and engineering velocity.
About the Team:The Fulfillment Web team builds the operational nerve center of Zepto. Our platforms handle complex state, dense datasets, and real-time workflows across Vendor Experience, Finance, Last Mile Logistics, and Supply Chain Planning. Because our interfaces power dark-store operations, rider dispatch, and automated reconciliation, every millisecond of performance and improvement in reliability directly impacts warehouse throughput and company margins.
Key Responsibilities:Build at Scale: Design, develop, and maintain modular, high-performance web applications using React and TypeScript, focusing on clean architecture and long-term maintainability.Own Complex Workflows: Translate intricate supply chain, financial, and operational requirements into intuitive, reliable user interfaces capable of handling large datasets, complex validations, and high concurrency.Drive Engineering Excellence: Write testable, resilient code. Contribute to shared UI component libraries, enforce strong typing, and participate in rigorous code and design reviews.Optimize Performance & Reliability: Proactively improve Core Web Vitals, bundle sizes, and runtime rendering performance. Instrument client-side telemetry and error tracking to guarantee high availability across operational portals.End-to-End Ownership: Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Backend teams from PRD to production, stepping in to contribute to backend APIs or service integrations when needed.AI-Native Engineering: Leverage AI developer tools to ship faster and improve test coverage, while building intuitive frontend interfaces for internal AI and agentic tools.
What We Are Looking For:Must-Haves:Experience: 1-2 years of hands-on software engineering experience building and shipping production web applications at scale in a fast-paced product environment.Strong Fundamentals: Deep mastery of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS, with a first-principles understanding of how browsers render, cache, and execute code.Frontend Architecture: Strong proficiency in React and modern frontend patterns, including client/server state management (e.g., TanStack Query, Zustand, Redux), asynchronous data handling, and modular component design.System Complexity: Demonstrated experience working on complex web systems—such as data-dense dashboards, role-based access control (RBAC), virtualized tables, complex multi-step forms, or real-time operational tooling.Core Engineering Principles: Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, network protocols (HTTP, REST, WebSockets), web security, and performance optimization.
Good-to-Haves (Bonus Points):Backend Exposure: Experience contributing to backend services, REST/GraphQL APIs, or server-side logic across any modern backend stack (Node.js, Go, Java, Python, etc.).AI Tooling & Product Exposure: Practical experience using AI coding workflows (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, MCPs, automated test generation) to boost engineering velocity, alongside exposure to building UIs for LLM/agentic applications (streaming responses, chat/canvas interfaces).Modern Web Tooling: Familiarity with monorepo setups, modern bundlers, automated E2E/unit testing frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Vitest/Jest), and client-side observability tools.Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

About the RoleJob Title: Senior Manager – Food Safety Advocacy & Policy ProgramsDepartment: Public Policy and Government AffairsLocation: Delhi
As Senior Manager – Food Safety Advocacy & Policy Programs, you will lead the company's advocacy on food safety and run its government partnership and policy programs end to end. You will engage regulators such as FSSAI and state food safety departments, shape positions on food safety standards for quick commerce, and design and execute programs with central and state governments across the full policy agenda — not only food safety.The role sits where regulation meets operations. It suits someone who can turn a policy objective into a well-run program, keep regulators and internal teams aligned, and show measurable outcomes.
Key Responsibilities:Food Safety Advocacy• Build and maintain senior relationships with FSSAI leadership, the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, the Ministry of Food Processing Industries, and state food safety commissionerates.• Shape the food safety regulatory agenda for quick commerce, advocating for proportionate, workable norms on dark store licensing, labelling, shelf life and cold chain.• Lead the company's engagement on draft regulations and public consultations through submissions, representations and meetings with policymakers.• Represent the company in industry associations and coalitions, and build alliances with industry peers on shared food safety positions.• Position the company as a trusted partner to regulators through joint initiatives such as Eat Right India, consumer awareness campaigns and food handler training.• Resolve regulatory escalations through constructive engagement with central and state authorities.
Policy Programs (all policy areas)• Design and run government partnership programs across the policy agenda, including food safety, skilling and apprenticeships, gig-worker welfare, sustainability, MSME and farmer linkages, and digital and consumer initiatives.• Own each program end to end: scoping, MoUs and approvals, partner coordination, rollout, tracking and reporting.• Define success metrics for every program and report outcomes to leadership and government partners.• Identify new program opportunities with central and state governments that support business priorities.
Policy Monitoring & Analysis• Track food safety regulation and other policy developments relevant to quick commerce, e-commerce and food retail.• Prepare briefing notes, position papers and impact assessments for internal stakeholders.
Internal Enablement• Help operations, quality, category and legal teams interpret food safety and program requirements.• Build internal processes for food safety compliance readiness and program governance.
Events & Representations• Plan and execute government visits, program launches, food safety awareness campaigns, and stakeholder meetings.• Prepare speaking points, presentations and reports for leadership engagement with regulators and in policy forums.
Required Qualifications• 7+ years of experience in food safety regulation, policy advocacy, government programs, or public affairs.• Working knowledge of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and FSSAI regulations on licensing, labelling and hygiene.• A track record of running programs with government partners, from MoU to rollout and reporting.• Excellent written and verbal communication in English and Hindi (other regional languages a plus).• Bachelor's degree in Food Science/Technology, Public Policy, Law, Public Health, Economics, or a related field. Master's preferred.
Preferred Skills & Competencies• Experience in quick commerce, e-commerce, food retail, FMCG or food service.• Strong program management: planning, timelines, metrics and stakeholder reporting.• Familiarity with skilling, labour, sustainability or MSME policy schemes.• Comfort working with operations and quality teams on the ground.• Strong interpersonal skills, political acumen, and a solution-oriented mindset in a fast-paced environment.

You will set the technical direction for cloud security, build the hard pieces yourself, and raise the bar for the engineers around you. We want builders, not people who buy security tools and monitor alerts.

Must-have qualifications6+ years in security, including at least 3 years of hands-on AWS security at scaleDeep knowledge of AWS IAM, SCPs, Organizations and multi-account architectureProduction experience securing Kubernetes and containerized workloadsFluency with infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar)Has built AI agents or LLM-driven security tooling themselves, not just used AI toolsHas led or materially contributed to cloud security incident investigationsCan set technical direction and explain trade-offs clearly to engineering leaders
Nice to haveRolled out or tuned a CNAPP or CSPM platform (Wiz, Upwind or similar)WAF, bot mitigation and DDoS experience on high-traffic consumer platformsDetection engineering on CloudTrail, GuardDuty or custom detectionsCI/CD and software supply chain securityPublic work: GitHub projects, talks, research, CVEs or blogs
What success looks like in year oneA clear cloud security roadmap, agreed with leadership and on trackPreventive guardrails enforced across the AWS Organization, with exceptions trackedCNAPP fully rolled out and tuned, with findings routed and remediated, not just reportedMultiple Security automations or AI agents in production that measurably cut manual workAI project infrastructure covered by baseline security controlsCloud incidents investigated faster, with lessons fed back into guardrails and detections

Role: Associate Director (Compliance)

The candidate should be adept at navigating regulatory frameworks, managing government relationships, and ensuring seamless business operations through proactive compliance.
